name: Montellà i Martinet (Spain)
description: Four horizontal stripes of green, white, black and yellow, the outer stripes twice as wide as the inner ones.
history: The official flag of Montellà i Martinet is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, divided horizontally into four fesses, the upper and lower of double width, coloured from top to bottom green, white, black and yellow; the white castle and the black martinet (hammer) of the arms have been transformed into the white and black stripes. Approved on 23 November 1992 and published in the DOGC on 7 December 1992.
